title: Read the settled site copy as one document before anyone builds a page
goal: The copy records the site-copy workflow settled are gathered into one document a person has read and approved, before any page is built and before the site goes live.

steps.do: This workflow runs after site-copy, which settles the copy records element by element; those records are what it reads. Follow the writing-documents skill and render the site-copy document kind, the catalog's name for the site's words as one reading copy (naive render site-copy), then read it for holes: a fact with no record is a record to write, never a sentence to invent.
For each hole the reading copy shows, write the record it names or raise the question, then render again, so the copy is a view of records and not a draft of its own.
Give the printed reading copy to the person who decides and say plainly that nothing above this rung is built until they have approved it.
Once a person has approved the reading copy, build the one interactive page from it, changing no fact, with the harness skill the adapter names for html.

consider.why: A question about how a reader moves through the page can only be answered by clicking it.
consider.when: A person approved the reading copy and the open question is layout or interaction, not what the words say.

steps.do: Once a person has approved the page, publish it through the publishing gate (naive publish), which is a one-way door in public and the founder's to approve.

consider.why: Published words cannot be unpublished, so the live site is the last rung and never the first.
consider.when: A person approved the interactive page and the venture's publication policy names the channel.

done_criteria.check: Does every sentence in the reading copy trace to a record it cites, with no fact the records do not hold?
